students.name: First name

questions.title: Question bank
questions.empty: No questions match these filters yet.
questions.publish_hint: Only a ready question can be put in front of a student.
questions.group_choice: The learner picks from options you wrote.
questions.group_text: The learner types or builds an answer you defined.
questions.group_manual: You grade this one by hand.
questions.topics_hint: A question can sit under several topics at once.
questions.manage_taxonomy: Create or rename topics and tags
questions.change_note_hint: Every saved content change is kept as its own version.
questions.try_answer_hint: Runs the same grading a real attempt will use.
questions.try_answer_placeholder: Type the answer you want to test
questions.try_answer_out_of_range: That number is not one of the elements of this question.
questions.try_answer_needs_secure_context: Matching and ordering need a secure (https or localhost) page to check an answer.
questions.needs_manual: This type is graded by hand.
questions.history_hint: Past exams keep the version they used; editing here never rewrites them.
questions.explanation_note: An explanation will be offered after the answer.
questions.hint_single: Mark exactly one option as correct.
questions.hint_multi: Mark every option that belongs; leave at least one wrong.
questions.gap_marker_hint: Use ___ (three underscores) or {{ }} for each gap.
questions.gap_marker_mismatch: {{markers}} marker(s) in the text, {{blanks}} gap(s) defined.
questions.matching_hint: Each pair is one correct match. The learner never sees which right-hand item belongs where.
questions.ordering_hint: List the items in the correct order; the learner sees them shuffled.
questions.show_separator: Show the separator to the learner
questions.unknown_type: This type is not available on the server.
questions.norm_trim: Ignore extra spaces around the answer
questions.penalty_hint: 0 means nothing is taken off for a wrong tick.
questions.context_hint: A question about a text or a recording stays tied to it. Moving a filed question to another text is done on that text's own screen, where both sides are visible.
questions.attached_file_hint: A picture or a sound the student sees with the question. It is chosen from the media library, never pasted as an address.
questions.trashed_file_hint: This file is in the trash. Put it back in the media library before publishing the question.

vocabulary.title: Word bank
vocabulary.definition: Meaning in the word's own language
vocabulary.definition_hint: A short definition the learner can read without translating first.
vocabulary.meanings_hint: Add one line per language. The word's own language is not offered here.
vocabulary.examples_hint: Show the word in use. Leave the language blank for a sentence you do not label.
vocabulary.no_tags_yet: No tags yet. Create them under Topics & tags.
vocabulary.lifecycle_hint: Only a ready word reaches a learner. Drafts and archived words stay with you.
vocabulary.initial_status_hint: Draft keeps it for you alone. Ready sends it to the learners straight away.
vocabulary.student_card_hint: Built by the same rules the learner's screen uses, so this is what they will see.
vocabulary.empty: No words match these filters yet.
vocabulary.no_words_yet: No words to study yet. Your teacher publishes them here.
vocabulary.try_again_hint: Try again in a moment, or ask your teacher.
vocabulary.my_words_hint: Every word your teacher has published. Open one to see its meanings and sentences.
vocabulary.no_meanings_yet: No meanings for this word yet.
vocabulary.pronunciation_hint: A recording of the word, chosen from the media library. Students hear it on their card.
vocabulary.trashed_audio_hint: This recording is in the trash. Put it back in the media library before the word is studied.

topics.title: Topics and tags
topics.tree_hint: Topics organise your questions. They do not hold them.
topics.tags_hint: Tags are flat labels you can add on top of topics.
topics.empty: No topics yet. Start with something like Grammar or Vocabulary.

media.title: Media library
media.search: Search by file name or caption
media.in_use_refusal: This file is still part of a lesson. Take it out of the question, word or recording that uses it before putting it in the trash.
media.empty: No files are in the library yet. Upload the first one above.
media.bulk_refused: Some files were left as they were:
media.upload_hint: A file is stored once. If you upload the same recording again, the library gives you the copy it already has.
media.label_placeholder: A caption your teachers will recognise
media.deduplicated: That file was already in the library, so {{name}} was reused instead of a second copy.
media.too_large: {{label}} files may be up to {{mb}} MB. This one is {{size}}.
media.not_available: This file is not available right now.
media.references_detail: In use by {{words}} word(s), {{listenings}} recording(s) and {{questions}} question(s).

reading.title: Reading texts
reading.new_hint: Write or paste the text, then group the exercises under it.
reading.search: Search by title or words in the text
reading.layout_hint: The layout only decides where the text sits on the student's screen. Nothing is hidden or shown by it.
reading.title_placeholder: For example: A letter to a friend
reading.body_placeholder: Paste the text here. Blank lines separate its paragraphs.
reading.words_after_saving: The word count appears after saving
reading.blocks_hint: Up to {{max}} blocks under one text.
reading.no_blocks: No blocks yet. Add one and put questions into it.
reading.instructions_placeholder: For example: Read the text and choose the right answer.
reading.block_deleted: The block is gone and {{n}} question(s) returned to the pool.
reading.empty_block: This block has no question yet.
reading.not_in_this_block: Questions under this text, not in a block
reading.unfiled_hint: {{n}} question(s) are under this text but in no block yet.
reading.open_bound_questions: Open the question bank for this text
reading.assignment_hint: Saving sets this block to exactly the questions shown above, in that order. A question you leave out is not deleted; it goes back to the pool.
reading.question_gone: (a question no longer in this text)
reading.learner_view_hint: This is the learner's own projection: only ready questions, no answer key, no notes of yours.
reading.nothing_ready: Nothing is ready to show yet.
reading.publish_hint: Students see a text only once it is published. A text with no ready question opens as an empty exercise list, so check the student preview before you publish.
reading.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.
reading.empty: No texts are in the library yet.
reading.my_readings_hint: Read the text, then answer the questions under it. Only your teacher's published texts are listed.
reading.nothing_for_you: There is no reading text for you yet.

listening.title: Recordings
listening.no_audio_yet: There is no file to play yet. Choose one from the media library.
listening.no_audio_for_you: This recording has no audio to play. Read what is given below.
listening.empty: No recordings are in the library yet.
listening.publish_rule: A recording is published only when it has a file to hear or words to read. Until then keep it as a draft.
listening.choose_file: Choose a file from the media library
listening.trashed_file_hint: This file is in the trash. Put it back in the media library before publishing the recording.
listening.allow_seek: Let the student move inside the recording
listening.show_transcript: Show the transcript to the student
listening.rules_hint: These rules reach the student's player. Leave the replay count empty for unlimited replays.
listening.transcript_placeholder: Type what the recording says, or leave it empty if the students should only listen.
listening.transcript_source_note: Up to {{max}} characters. The system records that you typed this text; a transcript that came from a document or from speech recognition is written by that pipeline, not here.
listening.cues_hint: Optional. Each line says when a sentence starts, so the student can hear it again.
listening.blocks_hint: Up to {{max}} blocks under one recording, {{questions}} questions in each.
listening.no_blocks: No blocks yet. Add one, choose its part of the recording, then put questions into it.
listening.file_length: The file is about {{n}} s long.
listening.interval_hint: A block plays only its own part of the recording. The file itself is never cut.
listening.instructions_placeholder: For example: Listen and choose the right answer.
listening.block_deleted: The block is gone and {{n}} question(s) returned to the pool.
listening.empty_block: This block has no question yet.
listening.not_in_this_block: Questions under this recording, not in a block
listening.unfiled_hint: {{n}} question(s) are under this recording but in no block yet.
listening.open_bound_questions: Open the question bank for this recording
listening.assignment_hint: Saving sets this block to exactly the questions shown above, in that order. A question you leave out is not deleted; it goes back to the pool.
listening.question_gone: (a question no longer in this recording)
listening.learner_view_hint: The learner's own projection: only ready questions, no answer key, and only the transcript you chose to show.
listening.nothing_ready: Nothing is ready to show yet.
listening.my_listenings_hint: Listen as many times as your teacher allowed, then answer the questions.
listening.nothing_for_you: There is no recording for you yet.
listening.no_plays_left: You have used the listens your teacher allowed for this recording.
listening.no_seek: You cannot jump ahead in this recording.
listening.playback_rules_hint: Your teacher set these rules. The counting happens on this page, so replaying after the limit is not offered.

catalogs.add_hint: Choose which exercises this collection holds. They stay in their own bank and keep their own status.
catalogs.bank_empty: Nothing in the bank matches these filters
catalogs.block_gone: The block this names has been deleted
catalogs.content_gone: This content is no longer in the bank
catalogs.create_hint: Give it a name and choose how a learner works through it. You add the exercises on the next screen.
catalogs.empty_items: Add exercises from the banks below.

catalogs.items_hint: Up to {{n}} references, in the order a learner meets them.
catalogs.known_states: Let the learner mark a word as known or still learning
catalogs.known_states_hint: The buttons appear under words, and only in this collection.
catalogs.name: Name
catalogs.not_servable_yet: Not ready for a learner yet
catalogs.nothing_to_serve: Nothing here can be served yet
catalogs.preview_hint: The same steps, in the same order, from the references above. Nothing is saved and no learner is involved.
catalogs.preview_shuffle: Mix the order for this preview
catalogs.rules_hint: These choices change what a learner sees when the collection is opened.
catalogs.shuffle_hint: A mixed run still shows every exercise; only the sequence changes.
catalogs.timing_after_session: Only when the run is finished

catalogs.timing_hint_instant: The learner sees right or wrong as soon as they answer.
